title: xs-parley relay frames v1
description: Frames exchanged between an xs-parley client and the relay (SPEC §6.3). One frame is one text WebSocket message holding a UTF-8 JSON object of at most 65536 bytes. Members not listed here are ignored by the receiver, so objects accept additional properties. The root accepts a client-to-relay frame (C→R) or a relay-to-client frame (R→C); validate against #/$defs/clientFrame or #/$defs/serverFrame to know the direction.

version.description: Protocol version; any other value is answered with error bad_frame.

id.description: Correlation id chosen by the client, copied into the response.

certBox.description: Member certificate sealed with K_grp (SPEC §4.2), base64url. Opaque to the relay.

envelope.description: End-to-end envelope (SPEC §5.1). The relay never decodes it and copies it byte for byte from send to deliver.

inviteId.description: Invitation identifier derived from the invitation code (SPEC §6.3), 128 bits, base64url without padding. Same shape as parley_id; the relay never sees the code itself.

claim.description: Identifier of a pending claim, generated by the relay.

inviteBox.description: Invitation payload sealed end to end between the holder and the claimant, base64url, at most 8192 characters. Opaque to the relay, relayed as received.

epk.description: Ephemeral X25519 public key of the claimant: exactly 32 bytes, base64url without padding (43 characters, the last one encoding only 4 significant bits).

inviteReq.description: Invitation request sealed end to end for the holder, base64url, 1 to 4096 characters. Opaque to the relay, relayed as received.

join.description: C→R. Registers (parley_id, fp) → (connection, cert_box). Another connection holding the pair is replaced (it receives error replaced); the same connection only replaces cert_box. Response: ok. The other members receive presence online.

leave.description: C→R. Removes the connection from the parley. Requires a prior join (else error not_joined). Response: ok.

list.description: C→R. Requires a prior join (else error not_joined). Response: members, the requester included.

send.description: C→R. Routes env to the connected member declared as `to`. Requires a prior join (else error not_joined). Response: sent, or error offline.

offer.description: C→R. The connection offers the invitation inviteId: claims for it are forwarded to this connection as claim_request. Needs no join. Response: ok (also when this connection already offers it), or error bad_frame if another connection offers it or this connection already has 16 offers. Offers vanish with the connection; the relay never expires them or removes them after a grant, the holder sends withdraw.

withdraw.description: C→R. Removes this connection's own offer of inviteId. Needs no join. Response: ok, idempotent (also when there is no such offer, or it belongs to another connection).

claimFrame.description: C→R. Claims the invitation inviteId: the relay forwards a claim_request, carrying epk and req as received, to the holder. Needs no join. epk and req are required: a claim without them, or with invalid ones, is answered with error bad_frame. Response, later: granted (same id), error no_invite (no offer, holder gone or refused) or error timeout (holder silent for 120 s).

grant.description: C→R. The holder answers a claim_request with box, which the relay hands to the claimant as granted. Needs no join. Response: ok, or error no_invite when the claim no longer exists (claimant gone, deadline passed, not addressed to this connection).

refuse.description: C→R. The holder refuses a claim_request: the claimant receives error no_invite. Needs no join. Response: ok, idempotent (also when the claim no longer exists).

ok.description: R→C. Response to join, leave, offer, withdraw, grant and refuse.

members.description: R→C. Response to list: the connected members.

sent.description: R→C. Response to send: the envelope was queued for the recipient's connection.

error.description: R→C. `id` is present when the error answers a frame (and valid in it); absent for pushes such as replaced. `parley_id` accompanies replaced. too_large is followed by the closing of the connection.

deliver.description: R→C push. Envelope sent to this member, `env` exactly as the sender wrote it.

granted.description: R→C. Response to claim, carrying the same id; box is the holder's, relayed untouched.

claimRequest.description: R→C push, to the connection offering inviteId. epk and req are the claimant's, relayed as received. The holder answers with grant or refuse carrying the claim, within 120 s.

presence.description: R→C push, to the other connected members of the parley. online=true carries the member's cert_box; online=false carries none.
